title: Pinned reference-runtime rebuild exceeded available workspace quota

minimal_reproducer.operation: build the pinned mncs-language main checkout in a temporary worktree with its standard Cargo target
minimal_reproducer.observation: compilation reached code generation and failed when the workspace filesystem quota was exhausted; temporary worktree was removed

expected_semantics: The campaign should be able to build the exact pinned runtime or clearly identify why an observed binary is being used instead.
actual_behavior_limitation: The pinned build could not complete under the available workspace quota. The existing local executable from checkout 90a36226ff0ad4d696b361afc813792963b54db8 was used with its SHA-256 and observed revision recorded in every witness.
why_capability_matters: A debugger witness must not conflate a moving local executable with the pinned design baseline; build failure affects confidence and reproducibility, not MNCS execution semantics directly.
current_workaround: Use the pre-existing executable only as an explicitly labeled independent/reference witness, preserve its digest/revision, and keep the pinned SHA in the baseline file.

host_language_code_required.why: Compiler build and workspace storage are host/toolchain concerns; the debugger does not fake a pinned build.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: No MNCS primitive proposed. CI should provide a reproducible pinned runtime artifact or sufficient build quota and record its digest.
alternatives_considered: claim the local binary is pinned
resolution_criteria: A clean build or signed artifact for the exact pinned runtime is available and its digest is recorded before a future campaign compares semantic behavior.

campaign_review.disposition: Workspace quota prevents the pinned rebuild; this is an operational boundary and is deferred rather than resolved.
campaign_review.workaround: Keep observed binary digest/revision distinct from pinned source revision.
